description.en: A glossy dark mouse-like figure with very large round ears, round eyes, a short smiling mouth and a long thin tail wears a red hard hat and matching reflective workwear. It lifts one hand with its palm forward while the other arm extends slightly to the side; the tail curves beside its short feet. Chest pockets and a white circular emblem remain visible. The complete original JPEG, including its original background and embedded metadata, is preserved.

description.zh: 一只圆眼的黄色角色穿红色背心和短裤站立。来源标题将这张造型图标为“恶搞之家奶图威”。

title.en: Naiwa resting on the train

description.en: A yellow Naiwa figure sits by a train window. The source title describes Naiwa as dozing on the train.
description.zh: 一只黄色奶蛙坐在列车窗边的座位上，安静地望向车窗。来源标题描述为在列车上打盹。

title.en: Naiwa stands confidently with folded arms

description.en: A yellow Naiwa figure stands with arms folded and a calm smile. The source title describes the pose as confident.
description.zh: 黄色奶蛙双臂交叉站立，带着平静的微笑。来源标题称其为自信站立。

title.en: Naiwa as Peter Griffin

description.en: A yellow Naiwa figure wears a white shirt, green pants and a belt in a Family Guy Peter Griffin parody. The source title uses a Naiwa-themed name for the character.
description.zh: 黄色奶蛙形象穿着白衬衫、绿裤和腰带，造型呼应《恶搞之家》彼得·格里芬。来源标题使用“彼得奶里芬”这一称呼。

title.en: Trying not to laugh in class

description.en: Two Naiwa figures sit at classroom desks, with one appearing to hold back a laugh. The source title describes it as Naiwa trying not to laugh in class.
description.zh: 两只奶蛙坐在课桌前，其中一只露出憋笑的表情。来源标题将这张图标为“奶蛙上课憋笑”。

title.en: Naiwa gives you a sidelong look
title.zh: 奶蛙挺着肚子斜眼看你

description.en: A yellow Naiwa figure holds its belly and gives a sidelong look. The source title describes the pose as belly out and looking sideways.
description.zh: 黄色奶蛙一手扶着肚子，侧眼看向前方。来源标题描述了挺肚和斜眼的姿态。

title.en: Switching to Thanos mode

description.en: A purple Naiwa figure wears a gem-studded gauntlet. The image caption reads “Switching to Thanos mode.”
description.zh: 紫色奶蛙戴着镶有宝石的手套，图片字幕写着“切换灭霸模式”。

title.en: Nino Naiwa goes on the attack

description.en: An anime scene has a yellow Naiwa face composited over a character. The subtitle says “Nailong has to attack boldly,” matching the source title’s bold-attack theme.
description.zh: 动漫画面中的角色被换上奶蛙的黄色脸部，字幕写着“奶龙就是要大胆进攻才行”。来源标题将这张图称为“中野二奶蛙大胆进攻”。

title.en: Naiwa rides Feidudu on a happy run
title.zh: 奶蛙骑着肥嘟嘟快乐奔跑

description.en: In this animated image, Naiwa rides on the back of a round yellow character as they move forward. The source title describes a happy run with Feidudu.
description.zh: 动图里黄色奶蛙坐在圆滚滚的黄色角色背上，一起向前移动。来源标题描述为骑着肥嘟嘟快乐奔跑。

title.en: The Naiwa hero gives you a thumbs-up

description.en: A Naiwa figure in a blue superhero suit raises one finger in a thumbs-up gesture. The source title describes the character giving you a like.
description.zh: 一只穿着蓝色英雄服的奶蛙举起手指点赞。来源标题称其为“奶国人给你点赞”。
